clock_contract.clock: one frozen 16:00-NY daily decision clock; state on completed bar t; entry at bar t+1 open, exit at bar t+1 close — SINGLE-BAR HOLD LAW (§1)
clock_contract.open_gap_exception_s4_F3: OPEN-GAP state formed from close(t) and open(t+1), knowable at t+1 open; forced fill AT that open is the ONE declared same-bar exception; exit mapping: any condition knowable at a bar close executes at the next bar's open (V7 F-A7-PL-1 class pre-empted)
clock_contract.same_bar_signal_fill: none except the declared OPEN-GAP exception
clock_contract.stamp_convention: 16:00-NY stamp convention (frozen): TD serves date-only stamps (YYYY-MM-DD, no intraday component), one bar per date, strictly monotone. The cycle's frozen decision clock (§4 F3) reads the bar dated D as the completed daily session whose decision close is 16:00 America/New_York on date D; state forms on completed bar t; entry at bar t+1 open, exit at bar t+1 close. The 16:00-NY assignment is the cycle's clock law, not a vendor claim; the vendor stamp is a calendar date.

configurations.mechanism_statement: A fresh 10-bar close extreme that DIVERGES from the 20-bar close-location-value (CLV) pressure slope marks exhaustion: price prints a new 10-bar close high while CLV pressure is falling (slope s < 0) -> SHORT; price prints a new 10-bar close low while CLV pressure is rising (s > 0) -> LONG
configurations.r4_trend_only_book: conditioning variable alone: the 20-bar CLV pressure slope traded without the fresh-extreme trigger — s > 0 -> LONG; s < 0 -> SHORT; warmup 60
configurations.sign_frozen: fires SHORT when fresh_high AND s < 0 (bearish divergence); fires LONG when fresh_low AND s > 0 (bullish divergence); otherwise NOT FIRED
configurations.state_formula: CLV[i] = ((C[i]-L[i])-(H[i]-C[i]))/(H[i]-L[i]) (CLV = 0 when H[i] == L[i]); pressure20[i] = sum of CLV over the trailing 20 bars ending at and including i; slope s = pressure20[i] - pressure20[i-10] (complete windows only — if either window is incomplete the state is NOT FIRED, fail-closed); fresh_high = C[i] >= max of C over the trailing 10 bars ending at i; fresh_low = C[i] <= min of C over the trailing 10 bars ending at i

families.ctl_complement: COMPLEMENT book (declared ex ante): the same position map with the tercile condition flipped — CTL-COMPLEMENT(MOM-L) = the MOM-L position map applied on HIGH-tercile days; CTL-COMPLEMENT(REV-L) = the REV-L position map applied on LOW-tercile days (condition-flip book; not an enumerated grid configuration)
families.param_source: construction logic (Q-12); regime pin from mechanism (MOM conditions on LOW tercile — drift persists in calm regimes; REV on HIGH tercile — overreaction corrects in stressed regimes), never tuned
families.plan_s5_definition: realized-vol tercile-conditional 1-session momentum and reversal, lookback {21, 63}; tercile formation CAUSAL, pinned: estimator = close-to-close log-return SAMPLE std (ddof=1) over the trailing lookback L; boundaries = 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles (linear interpolation) of the TRAILING 252-bar window ending at and including bar t, refreshed daily, same-bar assignment — NEVER full-sample (look-ahead class)
families.r4_trend_only_book: conditioning variable alone: the L-bar price change traded unconditionally — r = C[i] - C[i-L] > 0 -> LONG; r < 0 -> SHORT (no vol-tercile conditioning)
families.state_formula_template: vol[i] = SAMPLE std (ddof=1) of close-to-close log returns over the trailing L returns ending at and including i; tercile boundaries b1 = 1/3 quantile and b2 = 2/3 quantile (linear interpolation) of the trailing 252-bar window of the SAME estimator ending at and including i — CAUSAL, refreshed daily, same-bar assignment, NEVER full-sample (look-ahead class); LOW tercile: vol[i] <= b1; HIGH tercile: vol[i] >= b2; r = C[i] - C[i-L]; complete-window law: first possible firing at own-index >= L+251 (declared), otherwise the state is NOT FIRED (fail-closed)

fired_census_reference.law: fired census = COUNTS of state firings per configuration only (§3b). No candidate returns, PnL, PF, Sharpe, drawdown, survivors or S1 evidence computed anywhere. A state that cannot form from COMPLETE windows does not fire (fail-closed). Firing attributed to the fold of decision bar t; counted only if the leg's own execution bar t+1 exists in the SAME fold (force-flat at fold boundary). OPEN-GAP uses its declared timing exception (§4 F3): state from close(t)/open(t+1), forced fill at open(t+1), still attributed to decision bar t. FADE and CONFIRM configurations share firing events by construction (their frozen directions differ only), so their counts are equal within a threshold config.
